about: Every token here must be refused with 401. The kit's test JWKS server mints each by name; a name with no minter, or a minter not listed here, fails the kit's tests.

cases.name: missing_kid
cases.describes: valid signature, no kid in the header

cases.name: unknown_kid
cases.describes: signed by a key the JWKS does not publish

cases.name: alg_hs256_public_key
cases.describes: HS256 keyed with the RSA modulus (algorithm confusion)

cases.name: alg_rs384
cases.describes: a correctly signed token with an algorithm other than RS256

cases.name: no_email
cases.describes: valid in every way but carries no email claim

cases.name: empty_email
cases.describes: an email claim that is the empty string

cases.name: empty_signature
cases.describes: three segments, empty signature, alg RS256
